The process

How to convert PDF to Word online in 3 steps

  2. 02

  3. 03

Why PDF2Wordly

What makes this PDF to Word converter different

OCR for scanned PDFs

Scans and photo PDFs have no real text. Each such page is cleaned up and read with OCR, so you get text you can edit. Scanned PDF to Word.

Arabic and French support

Arabic text and tables come out right to left in Word, French accents are kept, and mixed pages work. The site is also in French and Arabic.

Tables and layout

Paragraphs, headings, tables and images are rebuilt in the .docx, so invoices, reports and CVs need fewer fixes.

One file, every page

Text pages and scanned pages can sit in the same PDF. Each gets the right method, and you get one Word file in page order.

Works in your browser

Nothing to install. Use the converter on Windows, Mac, Android or iPhone.

Short-lived files

Your PDF and Word file are deleted from our server after the conversion and download, within 1 hour at most.

No surprises

Honest limits, and what happens to your files

  • Sign-in is required for every conversion, on Free and Pro.
  • Free account: 1 conversion every 24 hours, PDFs of up to 20 pages (20 scanned pages) and 25 MB.
  • Pro: up to 100 files per 24 hours and up to 200 pages per file (50 scanned pages).
  • PDF files only. Photos (JPG, PNG) must be put in a PDF first.
  • Files travel over an encrypted connection and are never made public.
  • The PDF is deleted after conversion, and the Word file once you have saved it, within 1 hour at most.

What you get

An editable Word file that keeps your layout

  1. Text

    Paragraphs stay editable

    Body text converts to normal Word paragraphs you can edit, restyle, and spell-check. How formatting is preserved.

  2. Tables

    Tables and images carry over

    Tables, invoices, and embedded images are rebuilt in the .docx — handy for business documents and resumes.

  3. Edge cases

    Scans and locked files

    Image-only scans go through built-in OCR (English, French, Arabic). Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked first.
